%These are outer limits for these values to help it converge faster,
%for total force these aren't the absolute max limits because if we
%want max/min tot force then zero pitch and roll are needed
%outer limits for roll and pitch can be kept as is
%double 2* to assume a very generous arm of 2m
%If any hems oversaturates, decrease the forces it has to account
%This will sometimes clamp when not needed, could be avoided by
%checking if it's over/under sat and only clamping forces that
%contribute in that direction but that gets complex fast
%to prevent infinite loops, 0.9^50 = 4.2% left of forces which we
"HEMS saturation convergence failed, airgaps and/or angles are likely outside range"
%If F4 is too high/low it's from a combination so lower all. This
%has to be checked first because if it's too high it
%will cause other hems to always saturate
%Since tot force saturation limits are positive I'll count it
%as negative if it's less than gravity. Also total force should
%apprach grav not 0 to avoid infinite loops
%could be improved by checking if roll is helping make it
%worse or helping alleviate the saturation, same for pitch in
%redo force distribution and check if still saturated
% Set Fx = 0 as it's not relevant to roll
%Saturation limit(s) for each hems depend on its airgap
% minb, maxb, mind, maxd passed as parameters from ./saturation_fits.m
% r_roll, r_pitch passed as params. from ./pod.m

%Should this give more issues we aren't accounting for the
%difference between two hems brothers due to pitch
'min saturation limit is above max saturation limit'
